description: This file implements a testing logger for the klog library, capturing log output during tests, providing in-memory buffers, and integrating with Go testing interfaces.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A slice of LogEntry structs representing captured log entries.

classes.name: LogEntry
classes.description: Represents all information captured for a single log entry, including timestamp, message, type, and key-value pairs.

classes.name: Buffer
classes.description: Interface for in-memory log storage, providing string and data representations.

classes.name: logBuffer
classes.description: Implementation of Buffer, storing log text and structured data with concurrency safety.

classes.name: tloggerShared
classes.description: Shared state for tlogger instances, including test context, buffer, and configuration.

classes.name: tlogger
classes.description: Implements logr.LogSink, capturing logs, managing prefixes, and providing access to underlying test and buffer.

methods.name: NewLogger
methods.description: Creates a new logr.Logger for a given test interface and configuration, setting up cleanup and context.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns the log entries as a formatted string similar to klog output.

methods.name: Data
methods.description: Returns the log entries as a slice of LogEntry structs.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a copy of the Log slice, sharing error instances and key/value pairs.

methods.name: GetBuffer
methods.description: Provides access to the in-memory log buffer.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Marks the test as completed and records stop time.

methods.name: fallbackLogger
methods.description: Provides a fallback logger after test context is no longer valid, with warning for leaked goroutines.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes call depth from runtime info.

methods.name: GetCallStackHelper
methods.description: Returns a helper function for call stack tracing, or empty if test is done.

methods.name: Info
methods.description: Logs an informational message with optional key-value pairs.

methods.name: Enabled
methods.description: Checks if a certain log level is enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Logs an error message with optional key-value pairs.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Internal method to record log entries, format output, and store in buffer.

methods.name: WithName
methods.description: Returns a new logger with an appended name prefix.

methods.name: WithValues
methods.description: Returns a new logger with additional key-value pairs.
